newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen mixed,quiet but economic data ahead.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen mixed,quiet but economic data ahead.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open mixed and little changed on Tuesday, the final trading session of 1996, with volume seen light ahead of the New Year's holiday.
Several key pieces of economic data are due this morning with the potential to disrupt the quiet holiday atmosphere, analysts said.
A series of computer sell programs knocked the top off blue chips on Monday, with the Dow industrials closing off 12 points to about 6549 and the S&P 500 Index off 3 to about 754.
